description: Test cases for the SessionData-related components of the OpenClaw project, including testing session kind detection, token formatting, usage percentage clamping, and row flag labels.

classes.name: SessionDataTests
classes.description: Struct containing unit tests for session data handling and display logic.

methods.name: `session kind from key detects common kinds`
methods.description: Test that SessionKind.from(key:) correctly identifies session kinds based on key strings.

methods.name: `session token stats format K tokens rounds as expected`
methods.description: Test the formatting of token counts into display strings.

methods.name: `session token stats percent used clamps to100`
methods.description: Ensure the percentUsed property does not exceed 100.

methods.name: `session row flag labels include non default flags`
methods.description: Test that various flags are correctly reflected in the row's label array.
